attractions.name: Lempuyang Temple (Pura Penataran Agung Lempuyang)
attractions.description: Active sacred temple known for its split gate framing Mount Agung ('Gateway to Heaven'); about 2 hours' drive from Ubud.
attractions.dress_code: Shoulders and knees covered; sarong/sash required
tips: Queue for photographs at the famous gate is common
Mount Agung may be hidden on cloudy mornings
Remain respectful of worshippers and ceremonies
Wear comfortable footwear and carry water
attractions._source_file: Bali Indonesia/Tanya- Bali- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Tirta Gangga Water Palace
attractions.description: Former royal water palace with formal gardens, fountains, koi ponds with stepping stones, stone sculptures and spring-fed pools; about 20 min from Lempuyang.
tips: Follow local instructions on where visitors may enter or swim in the pools
attractions._source_file: Bali Indonesia/Tanya- Bali- All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: Keep sunglasses, phones and loose items secure at temples as monkeys grab visible objects
